title: Chapter 442
text:
This news was a little too sudden, and Han Technician could not react in time. After thinking about it, he realized that Aroshia had been in Grade C for quite some time. With the growth of her Esper ability, she was indeed about to enter Grade B.

Aroshia had a Grade A chain mission. The first round required him to guide Aroshia and help her reach Grade B. The reward was very generous — 520 EXP for the first round and a chance for a Random Reward. Han Xiao was in urgent need of a Random Reward, and this unexpected surprise made him excited.

Aroshia herself was very special. She said that she had been dreaming of many familiar scenes recently, which might be the memories she had lost. Every time Aroshia died, her memories would be reactivated, and she would forget all her previous life experiences. After a long time, who knew how many memories she had accumulated?

"When you enter the threshold of Grade B, there might be some special changes," Han Xiao said.

Because of the sudden situation, Han Xiao changed the destination and let the spaceship stop at the nearest asteroid.

Aroshia was not a player, and she was an Esper who could not be tracked. There might be a huge commotion when she advanced, so for safety's sake, he did not let her advance while the spaceship was moving.

Stepping on solid ground, Aroshia closed her eyes, and her body slowly floated into the air. Beams of dazzling light burst out from her body, creating an energy tide within a few hundred meters. Her Energy Level value increased exponentially.

Whoosh whoosh

A strong wind blew, and sand and stones flew everywhere. The airwaves kept spreading like ripples.

Around the spaceship, Han Xiao and the rest looked at Aroshia, who was in the middle of her advancement. Their hair danced in the wind, and dust blew in their faces.

"That's quite a commotion." Herlous used his hand to block the light.

"She's very special," Han Xiao nodded. "She's almost Grade C when she awakened, and there's a lot of energy hidden in her body. Breaking through to Grade B is a piece of cake for her."

Herlous' face twitched. "Am I the only one who thinks that it's not easy to break through?"

The eldest Volga patted him on the shoulder and said earnestly, "Be content."

The light energy spread out like seawater, quickly filling up the space within a few hundred meters. That area turned into a sea of light. The intensity and range of Aroshia's energy transformation had far exceeded its previous limit.

Buzz Buzz

All of a sudden, the radiance stopped spreading and suddenly surged toward the center at a speed several times faster than before. Countless radiance energy surged into the center, producing a rumbling sound that sounded like the whistling of a wind cave. The rotating dust of light condensed into a strong wind visible to the naked eye, forming a vortex. The center became brighter and brighter, but when it reached its peak, it seemed to have darkened.

All the energy within a few hundred meters was compressed into a single point. Then, this point suddenly expanded, exploding into light fragments that filled the sky. It turned into a faceless figure made of light. Its body was surging with energy ripples, and golden electric arcs were spurting out.

Gradually, under the effect of the Esper Ability, the energy turned into matter according to some unknown law. Aroshia's physical body appeared again and floated to the ground.

He turned on the analyzer and aimed it at Aroshia. The energy level she was currently emitting had already exceeded the lowest standard of B grade.

First Round Completed

You have received 520 experience points.

Risda Favorability: 5

"This Risda definitely has an unusual relationship with Aroshia, but who exactly is he?" Han Xiaoxin's heart moved.

You have received 1 Random Reward.

Suppressing his joy, Han Xiao temporarily stored it in his interface. He walked in front of Aroshia and asked, "How do you feel?"

Aroshia sensed it. "I can control more energy now."

"I'm talking about other aspects."

"I saw even more familiar scenes. There are too many, and my head hurts." Aroshia frowned.

Han Xiao lowered his head and stretched out his hands, rubbing her temples. His fingers gently brushed past her eyebrows, easing her frown and soothing the pain. He asked, "What other feelings do you have?"

"I'm not sure. Some of the scenes that flashed past seemed to be calling me over. I have a feeling that I should be able to remember some things if I go to those places." Aroshia gestured in the air with her fingers. The light energy outlined the scenes in her memories, one after another.

Han Xiao's brows twitched. Originally, Aroshia was not the least bit curious about losing her memories. However, after reaching B grade, she seemed to have awakened a more human side. A new desire was born, and her emotions were much richer than before.

Could it be that as Aroshia's strength increased, her secrets would gradually be revealed?

At this moment, a new notification appeared on his interface.

Second Round Mission: According to Aroshia's description, head to the various locations in her memories and help her search for memory fragments.

Current Progress: 0

Reward: 1030 experience points, 10 Risda Favorability:

Failure Condition: Aroshia's death

"The second round is to help her recover a part of her memories." Han Xiao's eyes flashed. Aroshia was so special, and her background was definitely not ordinary. If she recovered her memories, it was unknown whether it would be a blessing or a curse.

He felt that the current Aroshia was already very good. If she recovered her memories, her personality would definitely change, and it would be very difficult to maintain her current state.

For a moment, Han Xiao was somewhat hesitant.

Perhaps not doing this mission and maintaining the status quo would be the best choice.

No matter what, Aroshia was a very good companion. Now that she had become the mercenary group's second B-grade officer, she would grow stronger and be of greater use.

Including Han Xiao himself, there were a total of three B-grade officers. The mercenary group's evaluation in the alliance would increase, and they would have one more powerful helper.

However, this should be Aroshia's personal story. If he did not do it, she might recover more memories on her own, and at that time, she might take the initiative to leave. Thinking about it, it was better to do the mission and see how it went.

This second round of the mission was similar to a treasure hunt. Aroshia could only describe the scene, but the actual location had to be found by oneself. The universe was vast and boundless, and it was clear that there was more than one location. Although there was no information about this mission in his previous life, Han Xiao remembered the scenes of many areas, and it would not be impossible to find them without any clues.

"According to the nature of this mission, it's impossible to complete it in a short time. Sigh, let's keep it and slowly look for it. Advancement is more important now."

Han Xiao patted Aroshia's back, and got her and the others to return to the spaceship before taking off and leaving this small planet.

There was also a random reward in the interface. Han Xiao rubbed his hands, took a deep breath, and activated it.

[Randomly selecting]

Selection complete.

The type of reward you have received is:

Han Xiao's eyes suddenly lit up, and his spirit was roused.

There's a chance!

He subconsciously held his breath, and his heart was in his throat. He was extremely nervous.

Time seemed to have been stretched out, and everything slowed down. Three options were revealed one after another.

Please choose one of the three items below.

Small bottle of Potential Potion: Additional one Potential Point

Mechanic class blueprint x1: Randomly obtain a Mechanic class blueprint

Blank Character Summon Card: Choose a character, randomly generate a Character Summon Card for that character. Can only be used once

Han Xiao's eyes widened, and the breath that he had been holding back was instantly released.

Wow, a pile of trash.

I finally got a type, and you gave me this?

Han Xiao could not help but want to punch the table.

The flame of hope that he had just seen was instantly extinguished by a pool of urine. The ups and downs of life were too exciting.

I want a Mission Completion Card!
